postTitle: Stop Recomputing: How useMemo Keeps React Fast
postContent: React runs calculations on every render. Even expensive ones. useMemo caches the result of a pure calculation. It recalculates only when dependencies change. This helps skip heavy work on re-renders. In practice, useMemo shines when you filter or compute derived data from props or state. The key is to memoize only expensive operations, not every tiny calculation.

tehnicalChallange.title: Challenge: Memoize a filtered list with useMemo
tehnicalChallange.description: Create a component that filters a list based on a tab or search term. Use useMemo to compute the filtered array only when the input changes. Add a console log to verify recomputations and compare render counts.
